title: Thai-Style Oven-Baked Tom Kha Soup
description: A simple and flavorful Thai-inspired soup made with oven-roasted mushrooms, coconut milk, and spices.
instructions: Toss the sliced mushrooms with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast the mushrooms in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
In a large pot, combine the roasted mushrooms, coconut milk, tom kha paste, and 2 cups of water.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let the soup simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning with salt, pepper, and lime juice.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with fresh herbs or chilies if desired.
